title: My businesses
intro: If you run a sports facility, you can add your business and its facilities. An administrator reviews requests and may contact you.
empty: You have no businesses or requests yet.
limit: You can add at most {{count}} businesses; waiting requests count too.
pendingHint: An administrator will review your request; you will be notified of the decision.
requestIntro: The business's name is visible once approved. Your contact details are shown to administrators only, to check that the business is yours.
name: Business name
contactHint: A phone or an e-mail is required. Only administrators see them.
messageHint: At most {{max}} characters: for example your role at the facility.
venueHint: Search by name and choose the facilities you run (at most {{max}}). Only commercial facilities can be chosen.
noVenue: No facility with this name. If yours is not listed, you can suggest it as a venue when creating an event.
sent: Your request was sent. We will let you know the decision.
